# testdata Licenses

All files under `testdata/` were created for this repository and are original
synthetic data. None of them is derived from a third-party project, a real user
project, a real provider response, or any copyrighted source.

## old-projects/

Four synthetic legacy snapshots, each pairing a `fixture.json` (the migration
harness envelope plus the expected outcome) with whatever media the case needs.
They exist so the importer tests run against a fixed input instead of a live
browser profile.

| Path | Contents | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `minimal/fixture.json` | Two text nodes and one connection, no media | Written for this repository |
| `all-node-types/fixture.json` | Every built-in node type, a plugin node, chat, history, one asset | Written for this repository |
| `all-node-types/media/note.png` | 2x2 RGB PNG, 77 bytes, generated by a script in this repository | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/clip.mp4` | 24-byte `ftyp` box, the smallest payload Go's sniffer reports as `video/mp4` | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/tone.wav` | 8 kHz mono 8-bit RIFF/WAVE, 16 frames of a sine | Generated, not copied |
| `all-node-types/media/media-hashes.json` | SHA-256 of each generated media file | Generated |
| `missing-media/fixture.json`, `missing-media/note.png` | A project referencing one present and one absent media key | Written/generated for this repository |

The three media files are deliberately minimal rather than realistic so their
exact bytes and hashes stay stable and reviewable. Every identifier, prompt,
title and chat message in the fixtures is placeholder text written here; none is
quoted from a real work.

## Adding fixtures

`docs/ACCEPTANCE.md` requires `testdata/LICENSES.md` to state the origin of test
data. Any new fixture must be either original to this repository or freely
licensed, and this file must say which. Do not commit a real user project, a
real provider response, or a real API key — fixtures must not contain secret
material of any kind.
